statements.status_notes: msgpack 1.1.2 appears in the SBOM as a cataloger artifact sourced from jupyter_client's test-extra dependency declaration in its METADATA file. The package is not installed in the /opt/singleuser/.venv Python environment and cannot be imported at runtime. The vulnerable code is not present in the running container.

msgpack 1.1.2 appears in the SBOM as a cataloger artifact sourced from jupyter_client's test-extra dependency declaration in its METADATA file. The package is not installed in the /opt/singleuser/.venv Python environment and cannot be imported at runtime. The vulnerable code is not present in the running container.

CVE-2026-57585 is the same out-of-bounds read / crash-on-Unpacker-reuse vulnerability documented under GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964. The crash is in msgpack's C extension (_cmsgpack). This image ships no msgpack distribution of its own; the msgpack PURL comes from pip's vendored copy used by CacheControl, and pip vendors only the pure Python sources (pip/_vendor/msgpack/ contains __init__.py, exceptions.py, ext.py, and fallback.py, with no compiled extension module). The vulnerable C code is not present in the image.

GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964 is an out-of-bounds read that segfaults the process when a msgpack Unpacker is reused after a caught error. A SEGV is only reachable in msgpack's C extension (_cmsgpack); the pure Python implementation raises normally and cannot read out of bounds. This image ships no msgpack distribution of its own. The msgpack PURL comes from pip's vendored copy, pulled in for CacheControl, and pip vendors only the pure Python sources: pip/_vendor/msgpack/ contains __init__.py, exceptions.py, ext.py and fallback.py, with no compiled extension module. The vulnerable C code is not present in the image. pip is retained in the payload venv so az extension add keeps working, which is the only path that runs this code at all.

Alias of CVE-2026-57585. pip vendors msgpack 1.1.2 without the vulnerable _cmsgpack C extension; only the pure-Python fallback is present under pip/_vendor/msgpack.

pip's vendored msgpack is the pure-Python fallback only (fallback.py, ext.py, exceptions.py). CVE-2026-57585 is a use-after-free in the Cython _cmsgpack extension; pip does not ship that native module and always falls back to the pure-Python implementation.
